why: Not one result names a NAS model or explains how to get Reolink cameras recording to it. The only authority is Reolink's own support page, which lists continuous-recording methods generically and skips NAS entirely; the two brand-store pages are category pages that mention NAS in one line. Everything else is a no-subscription camera roundup (listicle) that answers a neighbouring question about which camera to buy, not which NAS to buy for cameras already owned. No major reviewer or tested comparison appears. A focused page picking a NAS by licence count, bay count and price, with a walkthrough of ONVIF/RTSP vs FTP setup and storage sizing for four cameras, would be the only direct answer in the set.
